text:
jen: Hey team — PR ready for the privacy-sensitive migration guide. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2897
alex: Nice. What's sensitive?
mike: Contains customer log examples and an S3 path that needs redacting. Asking legal + security sign-off before merge.
jen: @legal-bot can you run the checklist? flagged the PR.
legal-bot: Automated review: added legal-review label and checklist. Need explicit approval from @sarah for PII redaction.
sarah: I can review — will do today. Quick Q: do we need to drop the log example entirely or just obfuscate account IDs?
jen: Prefer obfuscate. Example line: `s3://customer-prod-1234/logs/2024-11-02/trace.log`
jen: Suggest replace with `s3://<redacted-customer>/...`
security: Also request removal of internal agent IDs and a short threat-model blurb. We can't reference internal ticket numbers.
alex: Noted. I can scrub commit and replace real ticket links with internal placeholders.
docs-bot: CI preview ready: https://deploy-preview-542.redwooddocs.test/2897 — build passed ✅
jen: Thanks, preview looks good. @sarah any blockers?
sarah: I left two small comments in the PR about wording and a redaction snippet. Approve once those are done.
jen: Pushed fix for wording and obfuscated the S3 path and ticket links.
jen: PTAL
mike: Security-approved pending one small change: add note under "security considerations" that public examples contain no customer identifiers.
security: I made a tiny commit suggestion in the PR, please accept.
alex: Accepted the suggestion.
sarah: Legal approved — adding comment 'legal:approved'.
jen: Great. Any preferred merge window? We have a docs release at 18:00 UTC.
leo: I'd prefer we merge after the release freeze at 19:00 UTC to avoid last-minute doc churn. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
jen: OK let's merge at 19:05 UTC. I'll queue the merge and monitor CI.
docs-bot: Merge queued by jen at 1802509700. CI run started.
docs-bot: CI green, preview rebuilt: https://deploy-preview-542.redwooddocs.test/2897 ✅
jen: Merged — thanks everyone :tada:
mike: Thanks! I'll follow up to ensure the internal incident link is updated in the internal handbook.
alex: Note for future: add a "sensitive examples" template in the contributor guide.
jen: Filing a small follow-up PR for the template. Closing thread.
